name: Storytailor
original_description: Connect your Storytailor account to create, read, continue and translate stories, build characters, and manage the Storytailor IDs you can access. Adjust reading preferences and Wonder Words, manage Care Circle and organization access, review story activity, and control connected Philips Hue lights. Changes are prepared for your confirmation and use your existing account permissions and allowances. Open Storytailor for its rich reading and listening experience, account security, parental consent and private reflections. The connection does not offer purchases, process patient records or make clinical assessments.
